AGR/2026/114.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibility: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Examplestan.
The landholding of the family must not exceed 2 hectares.
The annual family income must be below Rs. 2,50,000.
AGR/2026/114.how_to_apply: Farmers should register on the state agriculture portal, fill in the online form, upload the documents listed above and submit it to the Block Agriculture Officer for verification.
